title: pyrus aria subsp. latifolia
intro: Pyrus aria subsp. latifolia, commonly known as the Himalayan apple, is a subspecies of the Pyrus aria plant, native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the potential to act as an antidiarrheal, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus aria subsp. latifolia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit antimicrobial, anti-cancer, and cardioprotective effects. The plant's bioactive constituents may also contribute to its antidiabetic, anti-hypertensive, and hepatoprotective properties.
